title: Android Mobile Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role

The Android Mobile Developer position focuses on becoming an integral part of a team in an agile environment, playing an essential role in the design, development, and optimization of Android applications. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the implementation of high-quality technical solutions, promoting best practices in development, and researching new technologies to enhance efficiency while maintaining clear, reliable, and maintainable code.

Key responsibilities

- Developing applications for the Android platform with focus on quality and performance.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and develop new features.

- Debugging and optimizing app performance to ensure smooth user experience.

- Researching and integrating new technologies to enhance development efficiency.

- Ensuring best practices for writing clear, reliable, and maintainable code.

Requirements

- Android Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in Android development.

- Programming Languages: Knowledge of Kotlin or Java for Android development.

- Best Practices: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, clean code, and scalable solutions.

- Full Application Development: Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Version Control: Strong experience with version control systems.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Fluig
description:

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!

A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.

Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)

Essa pessoa terá participação ativa na evolução da arquitetura, qualidade do código e performance das aplicações, atuando em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e com desafios técnicos constantes.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter serviços backend utilizando Java
  • Criar e manter APIs REST escaláveis, seguras e performáticas
  • Implementar regras de negócio e integrações entre sistemas
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção
  • Desenvolver e manter testes unitários e de integração
  • Apoiar na análise de requisitos técnicos e funcionais
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas, bugs e gargalos de performance
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Frontend, QA e Produto
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, dailies, reviews e retros)
  • Contribuir para melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas

O que esperamos de você:

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java (nível Pleno)
  • Conhecimento sólido em Java e Spring Boot
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em JPA/Hibernate ou frameworks ORM similares
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou Oracle)
  • Familiaridade com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito)
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Noções de CI/CD e pipelines de build e deploy

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microservices
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Experiência com bancos NoSQL
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência com práticas de Clean Code e SOLID

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT.

description:

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Pessoa Consultora de Soluções
description:
Agora, DataStock, Neoway, Neurotech e PDtec caminham juntas como Trillia unindo conhecimento, tecnologia e inteligência aplicada a negócios.

Continuamos crescendo e estamos em busca de um perfil analítico e consultivo para atuar na intersecção entre dados e decisões de negócio. Seu papel não será apenas apresentar uma ferramenta, mas sim discutir estratégias de risco, viabilidade de modelos e políticas de concessão com os principais players do mercado financeiro.

⚠️ Requisitos Essenciais:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística (preferencial), Matemática, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa.
  • Experiência de Mercado: Vivência sólida em Instituições Financeiras, com foco em Ciclo de Crédito e Modelagem .
  • Domínio de Negócio: Entendimento profundo de como modelos de risco (Credit Scoring, Rating) se transformam em Políticas de Crédito eficazes.

Competências e Habilidades:

  • Perfil Analítico-Consultivo: Capacidade de falar a "língua do estatístico" e do gestor de risco, discutindo premissas de modelos e o impacto das variáveis na tomada de decisão.
  • Visão Estratégica de Risco: Entendimento de como otimizar a relação risco x retorno, indo além da operação e focando na inteligência da carteira.
  • Data Storytelling: Habilidade para traduzir indicadores técnicos complexos em valor real de negócio e ganhos financeiros para o cliente.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco total em gerar valor real, garantindo maior assertividade nas decisões de crédito e saúde financeira das operações.

Principais Atividades:

  • Consultoria de Negócios: Atuar como braço direito técnico em vendas complexas, diagnosticando a maturidade das políticas de crédito dos clientes.
  • Desenho de Estratégias de Decisão: Colaborar na estruturação de fluxos que unam modelos preditivos a regras de negócio inteligentes.
  • Provas de Valor (PoV): Analisar resultados de backtesting e estudos populacionais para demonstrar ganhos reais em termos de aprovação e qualidade do crédito.
  • Interlocução Técnica: Realizar reuniões de alto nível com áreas de Risco e Modelagem, defendendo a aplicação das nossas soluções no contexto técnico do cliente.

title: Creative Software Specialist - 64877
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

We are looking for Creative Software Specialists experienced in open-source creative tools to produce structured digital content such as animations, illustrations, video, audio, layouts, or interactive scenes. The role requires clear documentation of the creative workflow and the ability to submit organized project files and outputs.

Requirements:

  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Computer with 16 GB RAM or more (mandatory).
  • Ability to operate Linux/Ubuntu in a virtual environment .
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following tools: Blender, OpenToonz, Synfig Studio, Pencil2D, Kdenlive, OpenShot, GIMP, Inkscape, Krita, Audacity, Scribus, or Godot .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce structured creative outputs (animation, video, graphics, audio, layouts, or game scenes).
  • Maintain native project files with organized layers, timelines, or assets .
  • Demonstrate workflow progression (draft → intermediate stages → final output).
  • Document tools, effects, logic, and project structure for reproducibility and review.
  • Export deliverables in appropriate formats (e.g., video, audio, images, vector files, or playable builds ).

Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and a total of 40 hours per week with 2-4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 16 weeks
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-4 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent automated analytical challenges.
  • Once you clear them, you are ready to go!

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer with a strong focus on traditional infrastructure and on-prem environments.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who operates at the intersection of development, security, and network/infrastructure operations, helping bridge modern DevSecOps practices with legacy and mission-critical environments.

This is a remote position, supporting teams and operations in the United States, so fluent English is essential.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement security practices within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring applications and infrastructure are continuously scanned for vulnerabilities
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (Perl, Python, Bash) to streamline on-prem operations and reduce manual effort
  • Support and operate network security infrastructure (firewalls, VPNs, routing security)
  • Troubleshoot complex network and security incidents, including DDoS scenarios
  • Manage authentication systems (TACACS+, RADIUS)
  • Perform system upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management in physical environments

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in DevSecOps, Network Security, or Infrastructure Operations
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Enterprise networking (Cisco, Juniper, VPNs, firewalls)
  • Linux/Unix systems (RHEL, FreeBSD, bare-metal environments)
  • Solid understanding of:
  • Routing & security protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, IPsec, MACSec)
  • Experience with:
  • CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Puppet, Terraform)
  • Scripting/automation (Python, Bash)
  • Perl is essential — you’ll be working with and evolving legacy automation frameworks.
  • This role is best suited for engineers with strong hands-on experience in traditional infrastructure and network security operations, especially in physical / on-prem environments where routing, VPNs, firewalls, authentication systems, and incident troubleshooting are part of the day-to-day work.

Nice to Have

  • Security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CEH)
  • Monitoring & observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
  • Firewall technologies (iptables, IPFW)
  • Familiarity with JSON, YAML, XML

Additional Details

  • Location: Remote (supporting U.S. operations)
  • Time Zone: U.S.-based working hours

Why This Role?

This is not a typical DevSecOps position.

You’ll be working in real-world, high-impact environments, combining:

  • legacy infrastructure
  • modern automation
  • and critical security operations

Ideal for engineers who enjoy hands-on problem solving and deep infrastructure work.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.

title: Bolsista Doutor em Tecnologia - Imunova - Plataforma de Monitoramento de Saúde Animal e outros sistemas
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a empresa e oportunidade:

A Imunova nasce do encontro entre imunologia e inovação — com um propósito claro: transformar ciência em soluções biotecnológicas de ponta para pesquisa e diagnóstico da imunidade animal, conectando o rigor acadêmico às necessidades reais da agroindústria.

Criada por ex-alunos e professores ligados à UFPR, a Imunova surgiu como startup incubada na universidade em 2011, levando para o mercado aquilo que a academia faz de melhor: perguntas bem-feitas, método, e profundidade na interpretação dos resultados. A empresa construiu sua trajetória investigando, por exemplo, a ação de vacinas, probióticos, medicamentos e aditivos de ração sobre o sistema imune dos animais — e mantendo como marca a curiosidade contínua e a busca por evidências.

Desde 2019, instalada no Tecnoparque da PUC-PR, a Imunova reforça uma ideia poderosa: pesquisa não é um fim — é a solução. Mais do que gerar dados, ela se diferencia por interpretar resultados e propor ações , ajudando a impulsionar a avicultura, suinocultura e bovinocultura com tecnologias que elevam saúde, desempenho e sanidade dos produtos finais.

Sua identidade se sustenta em uma missão ambiciosa: contribuir para a soberania tecnológica do Brasil em insumos e técnicas avançadas, formando pessoas e construindo conhecimento aplicável. E faz isso guiada por valores essenciais: ética, rigor científico e respeito a colaboradores e parceiros.

Projeto: Plataforma de Monitoramento de Saúde Animal e outros sistemas.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Idioma: Inglês intermediário a avançado (leitura técnica)

Principais Atividades:

  • Auxiliar na construção de uma interface que automatiza a integração de modelos preditivos validados cientificamente, combinando dados em tempo real (IoT) com variáveis biológicas e de manejo, permitindo antecipar riscos e otimizar intervenções.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações web (frontend e backend).
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs e integração entre sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas para análise e manipulação de dados (Python, R ou similares).
  • Entendimento básico de modelos preditivos e fluxos de dados.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com dados em tempo real (IoT), incluindo leitura, processamento e integração.
  • Experiência git/documentação de software.

Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

title: Analista de Pricing, Rentabilidade e Custos Sênior - Starbucks
description:
A posição tem grande foco em análise de rentabilidade e custos variáveis dentro da operação Starbucks. A pessoa vai acompanhar indicadores de consumo de insumos para identificar desvios, desperdícios ou oportunidades de eficiência nas lojas.

O trabalho envolve análise de dados históricos para entender drivers de custo, estruturar forecast e apoiar o planejamento e orçamento da operação, propondo planos de ação junto às áreas de negócio para otimizar custos e melhorar a rentabilidade das lojas.

Como será o seu desafio?

  • Analisar rentabilidade por segmento: Avaliar lucro e desempenho por canal de vendas (lojas próprias, franquias, e-commerce, etc.) e tipo de loja, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar CoGS e margem de contribuição: Acompanhar os custos dos produtos vendidos e a margem de contribuição, assegurando precificação competitiva e margens saudáveis.
  • Elaborar relatórios financeiros: Criar relatórios gerenciais sobre rentabilidade, custos e indicadores econômicos (como inflação), fornecendo informações claras para a tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver planos de melhoria: Propor e implementar ações para otimizar a rentabilidade dos produtos, como ajustes de preço, redução de custos e melhoria de mix de produto.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas: Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Operações, Marketing, Supply Chain e Controladoria para otimizar margens e apoiar lançamentos de produtos.
  • Automatizar processos: Identificar atividades manuais rotineiras e desenvolver soluções automatizadas (scripts, dashboards, macros, etc.) que aumentem a eficiência das análises.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ingredientes Para o Combo:

  • Formação: Bacharelado em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Experiência com análise de dados e indicadores financeiros. Domínio de Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas, macros) e familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) ou sistemas ERP/BI da empresa.

Desejável

  • Visão estratégica: Entendimento de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e visão de negócio para orientar ações que melhorem lucro e eficiência.
  • Comunicação e colaboração: Boa capacidade de comunicação para apresentar insights de forma simples a diferentes públicos, além de habilidade para trabalhar em equipes multifuncionais.

title: Técnico de manufatura

title: Sustainability Specialist
description:
Junior Sustainability Specialist

Location : Remote (Brazil)

Contract : 6 months - 40 hours/wk

Rate : $4-6/hr USD - BRL $4,330-5,200 / month

Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an entry‑level Sustainability Analyst / Sustainability Specialist to join our client's growing sustainability function. This role will support a small, highly collaborative sustainability team of two and will play a hands‑on role in sustainability reporting, environmental impact analysis, and data‑driven research initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate with relevant academic or project experience, or an early‑career professional (1–3 years of experience) looking to grow their career in corporate sustainability within a global SaaS organization. The role is fully remote within Brazil and requires strong English communication skills due to close collaboration with international stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support sustainability reporting initiatives, including data collection, validation, and preparation of internal and external sustainability disclosures.
  • Perform Excel‑based data analysis related to environmental and sustainability metrics, including working with large datasets to identify trends and insights.
  • Assist with environmental impact reporting, including drafting written content and supporting documentation for sustainability reports and customer‑facing materials.
  • Conduct customer and market research related to sustainability programs, expectations, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with the sustainability team and cross‑functional partners to support ongoing sustainability initiatives and operational priorities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience supporting sustainability or ESG reporting through academic projects, internships, or professional roles.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis using pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic data validation techniques.
  • Experience conducting structured research and synthesizing findings into clear written outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to carbon accounting, greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories, or climate‑related data analysis.
  • Familiarity with sustainability or ESG frameworks (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) through coursework or practical experience.
  • Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or professional services environment.
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where priorities may evolve quickly.

We may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, or selection of potential applicants for this position.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:
About the Team

SRE Middleware & Data (SRE M&D) enables product teams by providing secure, scalable, and automated data, middleware, and AI services on Azure.

Provisioning: Automates secure delivery of databases, queues, caches, and AI services/resources; builds self-service and guardrails.

Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production; builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability.
  • Lead cross-team initiatives:
  • Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams; ensure adoption of architecture standards.
  • Run design reviews and architecture signoffs; surface and mitigate risks and complexity early.
  • Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery.
  • Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly.

Drive roadmap and execution:

  • Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management.
  • Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus).

Establish engineering excellence:

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices.
  • Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies.
  • Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems.
  • Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics.
  • Champion security and compliance by design:
  • Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene.
  • Guardrails in self-service flows; auditability and evidence collection.
  • Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews.

Partner with the Architects:

  • Codevelop platform architecture and service standards.
  • Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services.
  • Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes.

Own delivery outcomes:

  • Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two.
  • Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency.
  • Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder.

Operate a healthy on-call:

  • High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted).
  • Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction.
  • Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening.

Initiatives You Will Lead:

  • Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails.
  • AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents.
  • Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor).
  • Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production.
  • Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows.
  • Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services.
  • Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams.

Success Metrics

  • Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services.
  • Improved lead time for change and change failure rate; increased automation coverage and reduced toil.
  • Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests.
  • Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability.
  • Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention.
  • SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services; reduced alert noise via improved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor).

What You Will Bring

  • Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services.
  • Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB; Redis; messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus.
  • Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning.
  • Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC.
  • Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil.
  • Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners.
  • Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).
  • Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry.

What You’ll Need

  • Advanced skills in English
  • Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting.
  • Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry).
  • Database performance engineering and query optimization.
  • Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks.
  • FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback).

How We Work

  • Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects.
  • Automation by default; security and reliability are nonnegotiable.
  • Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
  • Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation.

Tech Environment

Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity).

Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search).

Azure DevOps for CI/CD.

CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ).

Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB.

Caches: Redis.

Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus.

Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps.

Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.

As they continue to scale our team, dealer network, and market presence, we are building a high-performance, agile, and people-first organization, and are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support this growth journey.

Role Overview

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) acts as a strategic advisor to business leaders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Dealer Development, and Support Functions in Brazil. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategy with business objectives, driving people processes, and enabling a strong performance & culture framework in a rapidly growing market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Partnering

  • Serve as the primary HR point-of-contact for business leaders across Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities and design HR interventions to support organizational goals.
  • Drive workforce planning, capability assessments, and talent deployment strategies.

2. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Partner with global and regional TA teams to define hiring needs and support local recruitment.
  • Oversee onboarding and cultural integration for new hires in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian labour regulations during hiring and setup.

3. Performance Management

  • Drive annual and mid-year performance review processes.
  • Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, performance conversations, and development plans.
  • Support the implementation of global performance frameworks adapted to local needs.

4. Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for employee issues, grievances, or policy clarification.
  • Ensure adherence to Brazil’s labour laws and internal policies.
  • Partner with legal advisors where required for sensitive ER cases.

5. Talent Development & Culture Building

  • Identify capability gaps and support local training, leadership development, and skill-building initiatives.
  • Lead cultural engagement programs in alignment with Client’s global values.
  • Support DE&I initiatives and cross-cultural employee programs.

6. HR Operations & Policy Management

  • Manage end-to-end HR lifecycle processes (payroll coordination, leaves, benefits, contract changes).
  • Collaborate with HQ in India for alignment on global HR processes.
  • Maintain HR data accuracy, dashboards, and workforce analytics for decision-making.

7. Organizational Development

  • Support org structure changes, role evaluations, job descriptions, and SOP creation for growing functions.
  • Lead change management initiatives during scale-up phases or new business launches.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/ Masters Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian labour laws and HR compliance.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and managing end-to-end HR processes.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural environment with teams across India and LATAM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese (mandatory) and English (strong proficiency required).

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving & decision-making
  • Cultural adaptability
  • Communication & influencing skills
  • Confidentiality and integrity
  • High ownership and agility
  • Ability to operate independently in a startup-like environment

title: Analista de Logística Pl (OTC & Faturamento)
description:
Olá! Aqui é a NotCo.

Somos um grupo de pessoas unidas por um propósito muito forte.

Queremos que você nos conheça, a nós e ao Giuseppe, nossa própria inteligência artificial.

Somos amantes de boa comida, mas acima de tudo, amamos o planeta. Assim, para protegê-lo, reinventamos a indústria alimentícia, uma deliciosa mordida de cada vez, elevando o que comemos por meio de nossa tecnologia à base de plantas.

Nossa receita? Ela inclui três componentes principais: ciência, tecnologia e, claro, talentos disruptivos. Trabalhamos diariamente para criar um futuro melhor.

Na NotCo, não estamos buscando ser a empresa perfeita, mas sim a certa. Estamos aqui para provocar mudanças, é por isso que ousamos, falhamos e, às vezes, alcançamos sucessos incríveis.

Para nossa operação no Brasil, buscamos a função de Analista de Logística Pleno , cuja principal missão será garantir a correta execução do ciclo de pedidos (order to cash), faturamento e gestão operacional, assegurando a acuracidade das informações, o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade dos processos, além de contribuir com melhorias contínuas nos sistemas e indicadores da área.

Principais atividades:

  • Responsável pela gestão da carteira de pedidos e acompanhamento do ciclo Order to Cash (OTC), garantindo o fluxo correto desde a entrada do pedido até o faturamento e entrega;
  • Realizar a entrada e captação de pedidos via Neogrid e SAP;
  • Executar validações dos pedidos (preço, disponibilidade de produto, pedido mínimo, rota de entrega, entre outros), realizando ajustes quando necessário;
  • Conduzir o processo de faturamento, incluindo emissão de Notas Fiscais de venda e retorno, criação de remessas, alocação de lotes, geração de faturas e validação de NF-e;
  • Atualizar e monitorar a carteira de pedidos, realizando reportes e acompanhamento de status;
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar os principais indicadores da área (OTIF, Fill Rate, OTC e custos), apoiando análises de performance e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Atuar em interface com os times de Comercial, Finanças e Operações, garantindo alinhamento e fluidez no processo de atendimento dos pedidos;
  • Atualizar e manter tabelas personalizadas no SAP, garantindo consistência de dados e parametrizações;
  • Apoiar melhorias de processos junto ao consultor SAP e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Apoiar análises de disponibilidade de produto e suporte aos processos de inventário.

Requisitos da Vaga:

  • Formação superior em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de carteira de pedidos e atendimento a clientes/canais;
  • Vivência com SAP (módulo SD);
  • Experiência com faturamento, emissão e validação de NF-e;
  • Excel avançado (Power BI será considerado diferencial);
  • Vivência em rotinas de indicadores logísticos e performance (OTIF, Fill Rate);
  • Espanhol intermediário será considerado diferencial;
  • Experiência com Neogrid será considerado diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e comprometido, com boa capacidade de comunicação e senso de urgência.

A pergunta de um milhão de dólares: Você está faminto para mudar o mundo? Porque há muitas razões para tomar a decisão e dizer: WHY NOT!

Hoje, você pode começar a fazer uma mudança pelo planeta sem mudar tudo o que você ama.

title: Product Solutions Consultant
description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping students around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

Cengage's Higher Education business, Cengage, supports learning and student success by providing materials and digital solutions to faculty and students enrolled in two-year, four-year and vocational programs. We currently serve more than 10 million of the 18 million students in US higher ed. Setting a new standard of service for our customers, we deliver quality, easy-to-use course materials from textbooks and eBooks to courseware such as MindTap and WebAssign. In the US, we offer Cengage Unlimited and Cengage Unlimited for Institutions. We help instructors be better teachers, we help institutions solve problems and we empower students to leverage the power and joy of learning to transform lives.

Our culture values inclusion, engagement, and discovery

Our business is driven by our strong culture, and we know that creating an inclusive workplace is absolutely essential to the success of our company and our learners, as well as our individual well-being. We recognize the value of diverse perspectives in everything we do, and strive to ensure employees of all levels and backgrounds feel empowered to voice their ideas and bring their authentic selves to work. We achieve these priorities through programs, benefits, and initiatives that are integrated into the fabric of how we work every day. To learn more, please see .

Job Overview

The Product Solutions Consultant plays a critical role in advancing strategic sales opportunities by elevating the value conversation and providing the critical expertise required to move deals toward successful closure. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, this role enhances and supports the efforts of both our internal sales teams and the sales organizations of our external partners as we drive toward our goal of driving adoption of Cengage Learning Platforms (CLP) within our markets.

The Product Solutions Consultant translates customer needs into compelling, outcome‑focused solution designs, using deep product knowledge, advanced communication skills, and a consultative approach. By guiding customers through technical, functional, and strategic evaluations, this role ensures that our solutions are clearly articulated, competitively positioned, and aligned with each customer’s strategic objectives.

What you'll do here:

  • Customer Engagement & Discovery : Conduct discovery sessions with partners to understand strategic goals, challenges, and success criteria. Build credibility with technical, academic, and executive audiences. Deliver high-impact digital demos, competitive pitches, and return on investment articulation aligned to customer use cases and buying criteria
  • Solution Design & Value Narrative : Own solution design and value narrative in complex deals, integrating CG learning platforms (CLP), Higher Ed, Gale, English Language Learning (ELL), and adjacent portfolios into propositions based on outcomes. Develop tailored solution architectures and value propositions that align customer needs with our products and services. Integrate cross portfolio offerings into cohesive, recommendations based on outcomes.
  • Sales Enablement & Deal Support : Partners closely with Sales Executives to accelerate pipeline velocity and improve win rates of complex opportunities by de-risking deals early and resolving technical, pedagogical, and adoption concerns and strengthen competitive positioning. Deliver compelling demos, presentations, proof of concept, and return on investment/value modeling.
  • Technical & Functional Expertise : In partnership with Customer Success, address technical, pedagogical, integration, and adoption considerations throughout the sales cycle. Serve as the expert for product capabilities and best practices.
  • Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop : Provide structured insights from the field to Product, Marketing, and Enablement teams to inform roadmap decisions, improve messaging, and enhance competitive readiness.
  • Cross Functional Collaboration : Work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Marketing teams to ensure solution alignment, smooth transitions, and strong customer outcomes.

Skills you will need here:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in EdTech, sales, marketing or product
  • Successful customer-facing experience with a strong preference for candidates with a consistent track record in sales, pre-sales, customer success, consultative selling, or solution development.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills
  • Highly motivated by collaboration and team work, particularly with the sales team
  • High degree of digital fluency; comfort with demonstrating technology platforms and answering questions
  • Ability to translate complex requirements into clear, impactful and simple solutions
  • Proficiency in leading discovery conversations and influencing diverse partners
  • Comfort working on complex, multiproduct deals and collaborating across cross functional teams and product deals
  • Experience with CRM such as Salesforce
  • Minimum B2 level of English skills per Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR)
  • Ability to travel to customers, sales meetings, etc. up to 40%
  • Experience as an english language teacher is desired
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, education/instructional design, information technology/computer science, or a related field, or equivalent knowledge and experience

Cengage is committed to working with broad talent pools to attract and hire strong and most qualified individuals. Our job applicants are considered regardless of any classification protected by applicable federal, state, provincial or local laws.

Cengage is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities including during our job application process. If you are an applicant with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in our job application process, please contact us at

About Cengage

Cengage, a global education technology company serving millions of learners, provides affordable, quality digital products and services that equip students with the skills and competencies needed to be job ready. For more than 100 years, we have enabled the power and joy of learning with trusted, engaging content, and now, integrated digital platforms. We serve the higher education, workforce skills, secondary education, English language teaching and research markets worldwide. Through our scalable technology, including MindTap and Cengage Unlimited, we support all learners who seek to improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

Por isso, nossa missão é ajudar quem busca um imóvel a fazer a melhor compra.

Como Analista de Pré-vendas (SDR), você será o primeiro contato "humano" com nossos clientes, com o objetivo de engajá-los na jornada de compra. Sua rotina envolverá a abordagem dos clientes através dos canais de comunicação (telefone e WhatsApp), educando-os sobre os principais conceitos que assegurem a melhor compra.

Estamos em busca de alguém que esteja disposto a aprender e se sinta motivado a fazer o negócio acontecer, e não apenas "bater o ponto". Em contrapartida, por se tratar de uma startup, você terá autonomia e a oportunidade de vivenciar a realidade da construção de um negócio de alto potencial desde sua fundação.

Se você se identifica com esse propósito e está disposto a crescer conosco, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Pré-Requisitos

  • Curso superior em andamento ou concluído;

title: International Customer Technical Service-Technical Account Manager-Brazil
description:
Job Description

Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a customer service interface role. TAM is responsible for the stability of the customer's cloud business and the overall growth, quality, and satisfaction of customer service relationships. TAM works closely with the Alibaba Cloud team to ensure that customer requests, issues, and features receive timely attention and priority handling.

Standardized Operations

• Maintain the stability of the customer's cloud platform through risk governance, product changes and upgrades, and emergency response to faults;

• Continuously optimize resources and performance to help customers improve cloud efficiency;

• Drive the continuous improvement of cloud product operation capabilities from the user's perspective, reduce the difficulty of cloud platform operations, and enhance customers' ability to maintain their cloud platform.

Standardized Cloud Migration

• Assist customers in business migration to the cloud, make good use of the cloud by providing technical services such as application/big data architecture design, database localization, application/big data performance tuning, data governance, and data platform construction, and offer best practices and solutions for cloud products in industry applications.

Cloud Optimization (Public Cloud)

• Build and optimize system architecture, establish business disaster recovery capabilities, design and implement monitoring systems, and guide regular disaster recovery drills to improve the stability and reliability of cloud-based business, ensuring system performance and response speed under high concurrency;

• Implement intelligent monitoring and early warning to enhance customer business efficiency and user experience.

Standardized Technical Operations

• Provide comprehensive cloud technology support, cost optimization, maturity assessment and consulting, compliance and security reinforcement services through standardized technical operation capabilities to enhance the efficiency and security of customers' cloud business.

Expert Services

•Provide customers with best practices, solution consulting, and services for Alibaba Cloud intelligent products;

•Combine customer cloud usage scenarios to help customers improve cloud product operation and usage skills through tools to assist customers in successfully migrating to cloud.

Job Requirement

• Over 5 year of experience in solution design, architecture, backend development, delivery, or operations for large-scale internet applications or enterprise-level systems in industries such as internet or finance

• Possesses a technical background with hands-on experience in developing or operating large-scale applications based on cloud products

• Possesses technical understanding and hands-on experience in one or more domains including cloud-native technologies, big data, databases, networking, and middleware.

• Masters the underlying architecture of core products within the supported business lines.

• Proficient in the specialized technical competencies required by the supported business lines.

• Understands cross-product system architectures and is capable of performing solution design or troubleshooting based on this expertise.

• Accurately identifies and categorizes customers and key stakeholders, establishing tailored response strategies for different customer segments.

• Creates a constructive communication atmosphere, focuses on key discussion points, listens effectively, and articulates messages clearly.

• Demonstrates strong service orientation—commits to fully resolving customer issues from start to finish and ensures high customer satisfaction.

• In specific domains, capable of engaging in prepared, professional communication with senior-level client executives.

• Possesses operations technology management capabilities, capable of conducting comprehensive reviews of customer business architectures and providing cloud best-practice recommendations.

• Acts as the primary owner for customer technical projects, including operational assurance, technical transformation, and stack migration initiatives.

• Assists customers in resolving complex technical issues and demonstrates strong capability to drive technical execution on the customer side.

• Exhibits systematic and holistic solution design and architecture skills, able to deliver reliable solutions in complex technical environments.

• Capable of decomposing complex technical challenges into manageable components, formulating integrated technical assessments and resolution strategies.

• Familiar with practical case studies across common business scenarios; able to tailor optimization solutions—including high availability enhancement, cloud operations assurance, capacity planning, architectural refinement, disaster recovery setup, cost evaluation and optimization—based on customer-specific contexts, proactively identify risks, and effectively implement tailored solutions.

title: Assistente administrativo

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $3,000 - $3,500 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Full Stack Engineer to help build, scale, and deploy the InFlightAI platform. You’ll work across the entire stack from interactive data visualizations in the browser to real-time WebSocket services and AI model integrations on the backend. This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll ship features end-to-end.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the React frontend, including complex data views, mapping interfaces, and real-time dashboards
  • Develop and extend RESTful and async APIs using Flask and FastAPI
  • Design and optimize MongoDB schemas, queries, and migrations
  • Integrate AI/ML model pipelines (ONNX, OpenCV, gRPC) into the platform
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets (live drone telemetry, mission tracking)
  • Work with Redis for caching, message brokering, and background task queues
  • Contribute to SOC 2 compliance features including audit logging, role-based access control, and security best practices
  • Manage containerized deployments with Docker and Nginx
  • Collaborate with robotics and AI teams to integrate drone SDKs (e.g., Skydio)

Technical Ecosystem

Frontend

  • Frameworks: React 19 and TypeScript for type-safe, scalable UI development.
  • Tooling: Vite for rapid builds; React Bootstrap and SCSS Modules for scoped, modular styling.
  • Specialized UI: Advanced data visualization via Chart.js and complex geospatial mapping using Google Maps API.
  • Streaming: Real-time UI updates powered by specialized WebSocket client libraries.

Backend & AI

  • Core: Python 3.12 utilizing Flask (REST) and FastAPI (V2 external integrations).
  • AI/CV: gRPC/Protobuf for service communication; ONNX Runtime and OpenCV for real-time image processing and inference.
  • Validation: Pydantic for strict data modeling and configuration integrity.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Storage: MongoDB 7.0 (primary application data) and Redis 7.2 (caching, IPC, and worker queues).
  • Operations: Multi-stage Docker builds and OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and observability.

Security

  • Authentication: JWT-based auth and OAuth identity provider integration.
  • Integrity: Append-only event logging with SHA-256 integrity hashing and granular permission management.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in both Python and TypeScript/React
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB and Redis
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, and production deployment pipelines
  • Ability to work across frontend, backend, and infrastructure without needing hand-holding
  • Clear communicator who can collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI/ML, robotics, product)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with drone or robotics platforms (Skydio SDK a plus)
  • Familiarity with industrial inspection, computer vision, or anomaly detection workflows
  • Experience building human-in-the-loop (HIL) AI review systems
  • Background in monorepo development with private GitHub packages (npm + pip)
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, NIST)

Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and real-time systems powering innovative robotics and data-driven platforms.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

- Liberação para Pagamento: Após a conferência fiscal, liberar a nota fiscal para que o departamento financeiro realize o pagamento ao fornecedor;

- Apuração e cálculo de impostos: Calcular tributos federais, estaduais e municipais, garantindo o pagamento correto e dentro dos prazos;

- Obrigações Acessórias: Preparar e enviar declarações exigidas pelo fisco, como EFD-Contribuições, DCTF e outras obrigações estaduais/federais.

title: International Treasury Specialist
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.

About the role

This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Specialist will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.

Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations

Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance

Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments

Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

  • Visão Estratégica: Habilidade de enxergar o panorama geral, definir direções claras e antecipar desafios e oportunidades.

Conheça a Blanver:

A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 42 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.

Essas serão algumas das atividades do dia-a-dia como Analista de Desenvolvimento Analitico Sênior

Realizar o desenvolvimento e validação de metodologias analíticas, de acordo com as normas exigidas pela RDC 166 e 964 (Anvisa), obedecendo os padrões técnicos e roteiros mínimos de exigências;

• Realizar o preenchimento de parecer técnico, bem como participação no Comitê Técnico, visando mudanças de processos, produtos acabados em mudanças dos processos analíticos;

Construção de Pipeline & Suporte a Negócios

  • Construir pipeline focado em laboratórios de diagnóstico, grupos hospitalares e redes clínicas

  • Desenvolver pitches e propostas customizadas para o mercado local

O Que Buscamos

  • Histórico comprovado em vendas B2B no setor de diagnóstico, laboratórios ou hospitais no Brasil
  • Rede ativa e relevante com decisores do setor de saúde
  • Experiência com ciclos de vendas de health tech B2B
  • Capacidade de traduzir valor tecnológico em linguagem de negócios
  • Mentalidade de startup: alta autonomia, disposição para arregaçar as mangas
  • Português fluente ; inglês e/ou espanhol são diferenciais

Estrutura do Engajamento

  • Dedicação: Flexível — de algumas horas por semana até tempo integral, conforme resultados

Por Que Isso Importa

Laboratórios e hospitais brasileiros estão sentados sobre uma mina de ouro de dados clínicos — ainda presos em PDFs, sistemas isolados e fluxos analógicos. A OpenHealth cria uma camada de dados unificada que transforma isso em laudos digitais, portais médicos, BI clínico e insights com IA. É infraestrutura real para a saúde digital que o Brasil precisa — e você pode ser a pessoa que abre essa porta.

title: Analista Meio Ambiente JR
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e protege a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Atuar na gestão e execução de programas relacionados à fauna, flora, biodiversidade e serviços ecossistêmicos no âmbito industrial e florestal, assegurando a conformidade com a legislação ambiental (municipal, estadual e federal), e adequando os processos de meio ambiente aos padrões de governança internacionais de biodiversidade, garantindo também a implementação das políticas e diretrizes corporativas da Arauco.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar no planejamento, execução e supervisão de ações de resgate, afugentamento, monitoramento e controle de fauna silvestre, doméstica e sinantrópica, assegurando bem-estar animal e cumprimento das legislações pertinentes;
  • Apoiar no planejamento, execução e coordenação de ações de resgate de flora, coleta de propágulos e destinação adequada da vegetação;
  • Apoiar no planejamento e coordenação de planos de recuperação de áreas degradadas atendendo condicionantes e licenças ambientais;
  • Apoiar no planejamento, execução e coordenação de planos de manejo de unidades de conservação e mecanismos de incentivo para criação e manutenção de áreas protegidas (ICSMS Ecológico, Pagamento de Serviços Ambientais, Créditos de Biodiversidade, entre outros)
  • Garantir a execução e conformidade dos Planos Básicos Ambientais de Monitoramento de Fauna e Monitoramento e Controle de Atropelamento de Fauna conforme periodicidades do licenciamento, reportando resultados ao IMASUL;
  • Capacitar colaboradores do Projeto Sucuriú (fábrica, ramal ferroviário, linha de transmissão e terminal portuário) quanto à Política de Biodiversidade e Serviços Ecossistêmicos da Arauco;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e implementação de Planos de Ação para Biodiversidade e Serviços Ecossistêmicos, atendendo aos requisitos e reportes de padrões nacionais e internacionais (IFC, BID, TNFD,GRI,CDP e outros) ;
  • Criar indicadores, monitorar e reportar dados ambientais, como riqueza e abundância de espécies de fauna e flora, áreas protegidas, áreas restauradas, interagindo com as áreas produtivas, visando a implementação de práticas que contribuam sempre para a conservação da biodiversidade e proteção dos recursos naturais;
  • Assegurar que os projetos de engenharia incluam critérios de proteção da biodiversidade (passagens da fauna, sinalizadores para avifauna, entre outros) por meio de revisões técnicas e fiscalização em campo.
  • Colaborar em programas de responsabilidade socioambiental, promovendo diálogo com comunidades locais sobre os impactos e benefícios da fábrica;
  • Atender auditorias externas na temática de biodiversidade e serviços ecossistêmicos, apresentando resultados, relatórios e evidências documentais.
  • Interagir com órgãos ambientais, consultores e stakeholders para alinhamento técnico e reporte de resultados.
  • Realizar acompanhamento em campo para garantir conformidade e orientar equipes operacionais.
  • Preparar e acompanhar processos de licenciamento junto a órgãos ambientais para o projeto Sucuriú, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e das exigências estabelecidas nas licenças;
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos ambientais e campanhas de conscientização, priorizando temas de biodiversidade e serviços ecossistêmicos, interação ser humano-ambiente e práticas de conformidade ambiental para engajamento das equipes nas metas de sustentabilidade;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentos, como Estudos de Impacto Ambiental (EIA), Relatórios de Impacto Ambiental (RIMA) e Relatórios Técnicos de Controle Ambiental (RTCA), bem como, acompanhar o atendimento às condicionantes ambientais previstas nas licenças e reportar status aos órgãos competentes;
  • Realizar o monitoramento de legislação ambiental (federal, estadual e municipal), através do acompanhamento das mudanças nas normas e leis ambientais aplicáveis ao setor de celulose, bem como, orientar a gerência e outras áreas da empresa sobre alterações legislativas que impactem as operações;
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas para garantir conformidade legal e boas práticas ambientais, assim como, realizar a elaboração e gestão de planos de ação para corrigir não conformidades identificadas;
  • Identificar oportunidades para aprimorar processos, reduzindo impactos ambientais e custos, assim como, participar de iniciativas para implementar tecnologias limpas e processos mais eficientes;
  • Avaliar potenciais riscos ambientais das operações e propor planos de contingência;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

Local

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciências Biológicas, Biologia, Medicina Veterinária e áreas afins
  • Pacote Office avançado
  • Conhecimento em identificação taxonômica de fauna e flora
  • Conhecimento em gestão de serviços terceirizados

Diferenciais

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – IoT Module

Founding software engineer for Quectel's new Manaus operation

Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil

Role Software Engineer – IoT Module – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (3–5 years of experience)

Type Full-Time, On-Site

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus

About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.

A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.

Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.

Learn more about Quectel:

  • Company website — quectel.com
  • Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history
  • LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil)
  • Follow us on LinkedIn

The Role

We're hiring one of the founding software engineers for Quectel's brand-new Manaus setup. You'll work on the embedded Linux software stacks running inside Quectel's cellular IoT modules — Qualcomm-based platforms supporting LTE, 5G, and LPWA technologies — and you'll be the go-to software expert for customers across Latin America.

Because the team is being built from scratch, you'll have unusual influence: the tooling, the development workflows, the customer-engagement model, the way we triage and resolve field issues — these are decisions you'll help make, not inherit. You'll collaborate closely with Quectel's global R&D centers while owning the LATAM software story end to end.

"You get the depth of an embedded Linux job — kernel, drivers, Yocto — and the rare chance to help build a brand-new operation from day one. That combination doesn't come around often."

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain software modules for Quectel cellular modems (LTE / 5G / LPWA) on Qualcomm SoCs.
  • Build and tune Linux-based networking systems for IoT devices and gateways — TCP/IP, sockets, routing, the works.
  • Develop device drivers, daemons, and system services on embedded Linux.
  • Hunt down issues across the full stack — kernel, Yocto build system, middleware, and applications.
  • Use Wireshark, tcpdump, and your debugging instincts to crack tough field and lab problems.
  • Support LATAM customers directly: develop new SW features, debug their issues, maintain the SW stack, and improve our demo applications.
  • Partner with hardware, integration, and QA teams during board bring-up and validation.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and performance optimization for the next generation of modules.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience with embedded Linux, cellular modem development, or both.
  • Hands-on experience with Qualcomm-based modem SoCs and their firmware.
  • Strong C and C++ skills, with a real understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architecture.
  • Solid knowledge of Linux internals and system programming.
  • Comfort with the Linux network stack and packet analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump).
  • Working knowledge of Linux networking: TCP/IP, sockets, routing.
  • Day-to-day experience with Git and Agile workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the communication chops to work directly with customers.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points For

  • Yocto Project or other embedded Linux build framework experience.
  • RTOS exposure.
  • LPWA experience (NB-IoT, LTE-M) and familiarity with cellular certification.
  • Prior FAE or customer-engineering experience in the LATAM region.

The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's cellular module portfolio — 5G, LTE-A, LTE Cat 1/4, NB-IoT, and LTE-M, all on Qualcomm SoCs.
  • LATAM in production — see the Furukawa Electric LatAm case study for an example of the kind of work you'll support.
  • Quectel blog & insights — deep dives on cellular IoT, edge compute, and industry trends.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent).
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment

Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.
